platformNotes.runtime: React Native 0.86 / Expo SDK 57 / expo-router. No CSS pipeline: tokens are TypeScript consts in src/ui/tokens.ts and styles are StyleSheet.create in src/ui/index.tsx. The html/css snippets below are web approximations for the panel only; they are not the shipped source.
platformNotes.units: All sizes are dp; all type is sp and scales with the system font-size setting.
platformNotes.scheme: One light scheme only (app.json userInterfaceStyle: light), confirmed product decision for daylight operation. No dark scheme, no Dynamic Color.
platformNotes.navigation: Headerless expo-router Stack; RackHead is the Material 3 top app bar. System Back and the hardware button are untouched. android.predictiveBackGestureEnabled is false, so the predictive-back animation is not opted into.
platformNotes.typeFaces: Native Android faces: sans-serif-condensed (Roboto Condensed), sans-serif (Roboto), monospace. Chosen because Material 3 names Roboto as the system face and asks brands to express through the type scale, and because Roboto digits are monospaced by default, giving every peso figure a decimal column for free. Offline load failure is NOT the reason — a self-hosted face ships inside the APK.

stock.note: Ground of every screen. Deliberately cool, never cream. Also the on-rack text colour.

stock-sunk.note: Recessed inset: fields, quiet controls, blocked stubs, pressed slots.

rack.note: The chrome: masthead strip and filled primary shelf control. 10.3:1 against stock.

rack-lift.note: Android ripple tone inside a filled primary control. Never a static fill.

ink.note: Body copy and every figure. 15.0:1 on stock.

muted.note: Label voice and secondary copy. 7.1:1 on stock. Tinted from the rack hue, never gray.

suppressed.note: An unselected slot once a run is chosen, and blocked control text. 5.0:1 — dimmed, never washed.

rule.note: The 1 dp rule between slots, above the shelf, and top/bottom on a statement band.

ochre.note: THE ONE ACCENT. The 5 dp selected spine, the focused field underline, the slot ripple. Live and selected, nothing else.

ochre-wash.note: Fill behind a selected slot. Ink stays fully legible on it.

refusal.note: Refusals, blocked-slot reasons, and destructive controls only. 5.9:1 on stock.

refusal-wash.note: Band ground behind a refusal statement.

confirmed.note: Settled, spent, successful: the punched serial, positive change, a matched closeout. 5.8:1 on stock.

confirmed-wash.note: Band ground behind a confirmed statement, and the spent-slot fill on PunchMark.

warning.note: RULE AND TAG ONLY, NEVER TEXT. 3.4:1 on stock, 3.3:1 on its own wash. Hairline of a confirmable warning; the stale staleness pip.

warning-wash.note: Band ground behind a confirmable warning. Its copy and its tone tag are set in ink.

on-rack.note: Text and control labels on the teal chrome.

on-rack-muted.note: Subtitle, Back label and register text on the teal strip.

figure.purpose: The fare panel — the number a collector copies onto a paper Official Receipt. Largest type in the app on every screen that has one; nothing else uses this size. Roboto Condensed digits are monospaced, so figures align on a fixed decimal column.

title.purpose: A screen's subject: masthead stall number, stall number in the lease list, the punched serial, and the text inside a Field.

body.purpose: Every message, explanation, slot line and blocked-control reason.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase (1.1 letter-spacing). Section captions, every control label, statement tone tags, the masthead register.

mono.purpose: Raw diagnostic detail under a statement, and the mono field voice for serials, PINs and credentials — character-by-character transcription, not prose.

extensions.shadowPolicy: There are no shadows in this build: no elevation, shadowColor or boxShadow anywhere in src/ui or any screen. Depth is a 1 dp hairline, a recessed tonal inset (stock-sunk), or one filled chrome field (rack). Material 3 tonal elevation is used in its flattest form — a tone step, not a lift.

motion.name: punch-settle
motion.value: 180ms, opacity 0 to 1 with the notch scaling 2.2x to 1x, native driver
motion.purpose: PunchMark only. The single irreversible moment when a receipt commits. Cut to an instant state change under Reduce Motion; if the accessibility setting cannot be read, the build treats it as on.

motion.name: press-filled
motion.purpose: Pressed state on a filled Punch. No translation.

motion.name: press-outlined
motion.purpose: Pressed state on an outlined Action and on a slot.

motion.name: press-back
motion.purpose: Pressed state on the masthead Back control.

motion.name: ripple
motion.value: android_ripple, foreground: true — rack-lift inside a filled primary, rack on an outlined action, ochre on a slot, borderless on-rack-muted on Back
motion.purpose: Android-native touch feedback, themed from the rack. A fluent Android user reads the absence of a ripple as a dead control.

breakpoints.name: verified-phone
breakpoints.note: Huawei JDY-LX2 over adb — the only device class inspected. Portrait is locked in app.json.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.note: The shipping device class. No tablet or emulator was available; nothing in this system is verified at that width.

touchTargets.name: min
touchTargets.purpose: Material minimum. Every target in the app.

touchTargets.name: shelf
touchTargets.purpose: The primary Punch — the one control hit one-handed, at arm's length, without looking away from a queue.

typeEnforcedRules.name: No disabled prop
typeEnforcedRules.body: Punch, Action and Slot have no `disabled` prop. They take `blocked: string | null`, where a non-null value both disables the control and states what is missing. `missing(...)` joins reasons so two missing things are both named. A dead control without a stated reason is not expressible at a call site.

typeEnforcedRules.name: No numeric money path
typeEnforcedRules.body: Figure and Amount take a RENDERED STRING, never a number. Wire decimals pass through fromWire(), which routes them back through format() from @ceedo/shared. A null value renders a stated absence, never the specific false claim ₱0.00.

components.description: The signature interaction and the only motion in the app. A validated serial settles into the spent state with a hole bitten through the ticket, in exactly the geometry of a rack slot — same gutter, same hairlines — because a spent slot and a selected slot are two states of one object. The hole is drawn, never a glyph. ~180ms, cut to an instant state change under Reduce Motion.

narrative.overview:
The bus and jeepney conductor's ticket rack: pre-numbered accountable paper held in ranked slots, one live slot, a serial punched to spend it, and the whole rack reconciled against cash at the end of the route. It is a layout law, not a picture. There is no wood grain, no drawn brass, no skeuomorphic perforation anywhere in the build, and none may be added. What the metaphor buys is structure: things that are owed are slots stacked oldest-at-top; a selection is a continuous ochre edge running down the gutter; the figure that leaves the screen for a paper Official Receipt is the largest type in the app, pinned where it cannot scroll away.

The world refuses the category default deliberately. Material 3's tonal card on a tinted surface is absent from this build: a rack has no cards, so this system has no cards. Depth is carried by hairline rules, a recessed stock inset and one filled chrome strip — never by a shadow, never by a rounded elevated container. Every value in src/ui/tokens.ts was chosen for a tablet held one-handed, in daylight, in a Philippine public market, by someone with a queue waiting and a receipt booklet in the other hand. Contrast and figure size are not taste here.

Two of this system's rules are enforced by the TypeScript types in src/ui/index.tsx rather than by discipline, and that is the single most important property to preserve when extending it. Punch, Action and Slot have no disabled prop. They take blocked: string | null, where a non-null value both disables the control and states what is missing; missing(...) joins reasons so two missing things are both named. A dead control with no stated reason is not expressible at a call site. Figure and Amount take a rendered string, never a number. Wire decimals pass through fromWire(), which routes them back through format() from @ceedo/shared, so no numeric path exists through a money component; null renders a stated absence, never ₱0.00, because ₱0.00 is a specific claim about money.
keyCharacteristics: Ranked slots and hairlines instead of cards; no container has a shadow anywhere in the build.
One accent (ochre) spent entirely on live/selected; three reserved signals that never decorate.
Four type sizes, in sp, and no fifth.
Every control carries a permanently visible text label; no icon-only affordance exists.
The primary action is a pinned bottom shelf, not a FAB.
Light scheme only, by explicit product decision (daylight operation).

rules.name: The Amber Is Never Text Rule
rules.body: Amber is a rule and a tag, never a sentence and never a tone tag. Warning copy is set in ink on the amber wash; the "Check" tag on a warning statement is also set in ink. This was violated once during the build and caught by review.

rules.name: The Spent Signal Rule
rules.body: Refusal red carries refusals and destructive controls only. Never a heading, never a rule, never a decoration, never the peso sign. Confirmed green carries settlement only. An accent that also rules a heading is an accent nobody reads.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ochre means live-or-selected and nothing else. Nothing decorative is ochre, and no other colour may mean selected.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: Four sizes exist — 40 / 26 / 17 / 13 sp — and a fifth is a defect. The incumbent screens used ten ad-hoc sizes between 13 and 34, and the relationship between them was invisible because there wasn't one.

rules.name: The Largest Figure Rule
rules.body: On any screen where money leaves the device for paper, that figure is the largest thing on the screen. Nothing competes with it at figure scale.

rules.name: The sp Rule
rules.body: All type is sp and scales with the system font-size setting; the fare panel sets allowFontScaling explicitly. Never a fixed px.

rules.name: The Fixed Reference Rule
rules.body: The masthead strip and the value slot hold the same position and scale on every screen. A collector should never hunt for either.

rules.name: The No Second Screen Rule
rules.body: Per-charge detail expands in place. Never a second screen mid-transaction.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadow, at any elevation, for any reason. A surface is distinguished by hairline, tone step, or nothing.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: The punch is the only animation. Anything else that wants to move is asking for a state change instead.

rules.name: The Spine Reservation Rule
rules.body: The thick left edge belongs to the rack spine alone. A coloured left edge on an alert — the category's stock costume — spends the one language that makes a selected run readable.

rules.name: The Band, Not A Box Rule
rules.body: Notices are bands. Only pressable things get an outline.

dos: Do give every dead control a `blocked` reason string, and join multiple reasons with `missing(...)` so both are named.
Do pass money to Figure and Amount as a string from format() or fromWire(), and render a stated absence rather than ₱0.00 when there is no figure.
Do set warning copy and the warning tone tag in ink on the amber wash.
Do keep the primary action on the pinned shelf, at 56 dp, with the fare panel directly above it.
Do put a permanently visible text label on every control, including Back.
Do theme android_ripple from the rack on every pressable.
Do use the four sizes in sp and let them scale with the system font setting.
Do state sync age in the masthead register on any screen showing a device-local figure.
donts: Don't add a `disabled` prop to Punch, Action or Slot. The absence of one is the rule.
Don't set a sentence, a heading or a tone tag in amber.
Don't spend refusal red or confirmed green on a heading, a rule, a decoration or the peso sign.
Don't put a thick coloured left edge on anything that is not a rack slot.
Don't shape a notice as an outlined rectangle; outlines belong to pressable things.
Don't add a shadow or an elevated card. There are none in this build.
Don't add a FAB — the shelf carries disabled-reason text that a FAB cannot.
Don't add a dark scheme; one light theme is a confirmed product decision for daylight operation.
Don't add a fifth type size, a second accent, or a second animation.
Don't add wood grain, drawn brass, or skeuomorphic perforation. The rack is a layout law.
Don't use an icon in place of a word, and don't draw the punch notch as a glyph.
knownGaps: The spent slot does not ship: no screen renders a settled billing period, so only two of the thesis's three slot states exist.
Rank does not ship: nothing carries a slot's position, so "oldest first" is a caption rather than a visible property.
The amount column is missing on `leases` — a missing row in the fidelity matrix, not a nice-to-have. The fixed decimal column is written here as a cross-screen law but currently exists on one screen.
The tablet device class is uninspected. All verification is a Huawei JDY-LX2 phone at 360x806 dp.
app.json is correct in source but unverified in the running binary: userInterfaceStyle: light and softwareKeyboardLayoutMode: resize both need a Gradle rebuild that was not run.
Keyboard-up state and font scale 1.3 were never captured, including against the one-line masthead title and the fixed 48/56 dp targets.
The splash (#208AEF) and Android adaptive icon background (#E6F4FE) are unreplaced Expo scaffold values, not rack colours. They are deliberately excluded from the palette.
android.predictiveBackGestureEnabled is false: System Back and the hardware button work on the headerless stack, but the predictive-back animation is not opted into.
narrative.provenance: This build ships no rasters — no generated images, no photographs, no illustrations. There is nothing to carry provenance. The only bitmaps in the tree are the unreplaced Expo scaffold icon and splash assets.
